text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Taah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With renewed determination, she continued her daily training toward the Oaks, until one day...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Phew! One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, huh? If it isn't Kuu-chan Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...—Ah,
Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's wroong? Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Just stepping out... to get some fresh air—
...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Kuu-chan-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha.
Sorry for causing trouble for you.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's not a bother at all—
Wait, is it seriously okay for me to talk already?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Um...
You gotta go to the clinic for a while, right?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
…………
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha!
Sorry for making such a gloomy face.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all! It's totally fine, I mean!
You might be my senior, but we're teammates, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Pretending you're fine when you're hurting...
makes me feel... really lonely, you know?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Pandora-san...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... Well, you see...
It just feels like I've been tumbling downhill
ever since the Victoria Mile, and it's frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Just when I'd finally found my own running style, started being called
the Queen of the Mile, and made it all the way here..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I really don't want
it to just end like this."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: It ain't over yet!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's not gonna end! And besides—
besides, I know!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like the dazzling coolness of dreaming,
and the strength to run while believing in yourself!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
That stuff is still right here with me!
It's still pumping me up!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way an amazing senior like Kuu-senpai
would go out like this!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Not yet, nowhere near, nowhere near, nowhere near,
Line Craft isn't finished yet!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You're right.
Thank you, Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so arrived the day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks).

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hell yeaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes, Kawakami Princess!
Do your best--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Undefeated up to this point...!
Plus, seeing that sheer, unyielding grit
is just so refreshing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: "There are plenty of strong girls out there, but Kawakami-chan's got this in the bag!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The oak crown belongs
upon this princess's head!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter what it takes, with pure grit, I'll snatch it away
and show everyone what I can dooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Kawakami-senpai.
Until now, I never really understood that vibe of yours."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Still, you know what? I think I kinda get it now. That burning passion of yours, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: That feeling of "I definitely can't lose!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Pandora-san.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Ohoho, it's been a while, and the look in your eyes has changed quite a bit!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wait, I'm not wearing my colored contacts today!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That is not what I meant at all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—*Ahem*! Very well!
Clash titan against titan and smash your way through!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The hottest, most fiercely contested Oaks in history!
Let's give it everything we've got, shall we?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'm gonna do it.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So you too, Senpai.
Don't let me see you crying♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes filled with a quiet determination—
The curtain rises on the Oaks!
